items.title: Micron Stock Rises After Musk Flags Surging Memory Prices
items.summary: FEATURE   Micron Technology stock rose Wednesday after good news about future memory prices from SpaceX CEO Elon Musk.  Micron shares were up 3.2% at $921 by midafternoon. That comes after a 7.6% gain the previous day.
